quick_answers.question: Is ICE ORCA DRAGON one undifferentiated knowledge graph?
quick_answers.answer: No. Hypercomplex algebra, legacy prediction/narrative history, and CPT temporal-folded SUSY remain independent research or memory graphs. This collection supplies only qualified navigation between them.

quick_answers.question: What survives in the hypercomplex programme?
quick_answers.answer: Several finite algebraic structures survive in their declared convention, including the assessor orbit chain, XOR regularity, finite identities, and an explicit S3 subgroup. The currently indexed hypercomplex subset does not establish Standard Model referents.

quick_answers.question: Did the legacy numerical predictions pass their recorded gates?
quick_answers.answer: No genuine P01-P15 or gravity signal survives the stored gates, and Git does not independently timestamp the declared prediction lists before their comparisons.

quick_answers.question: Is the CPT Gate 1 route closed or ready for Phase 57?
quick_answers.answer: No. Phase 56 and the three historical bounded Gate-1 windows are consumed; their retry, full replay, Phase 57 and global promotion remain forbidden. Distinct clean committed unnumbered calculations use one generic capped runtime. The trace-gauge branch now reaches an exact classical U_plus Darboux chart and, on compact interiors, a principal old-(P,p) to new-(c,p) FIO with phase -W, half-density D^(-1/2) and fixed local Maslov branch. The uncorrected one-term kernel is not exactly unitary because its geometric-mean composition density differs from the required secant/coarea density. That narrow KILL does not exclude a corrected full-symbol or spectral transform. Ordering, self-adjoint domains, edge conditions, global normalization and Maslov gluing, coordinate polarization, other components, replacement ghost/BFV source, old fixed-a equality, full-real-lapse distributional delta(C) rigging map, zero lapse, physical joint cycle and global vector remain open or null. Gate 1 stays open and automatic_next is null.

quick_answers.question: Is the user-primary ICE narrative preserved as evidence?
quick_answers.answer: It is preserved as primary narrative and motivation, not promoted into computational evidence. Exact source-backed wording is separated from later interpretation.

quick_answers.question: Has any of this been promoted into an external KG or a physics verdict?
quick_answers.answer: No automatic promotion is claimed. Eight historical CPT UID lookups resolve, but lookup resolution is neither external acceptance nor physics ratification; 40 bridges remain unresolved across the collection. The repository ontology is only a memory and index layer.
